title: Impression & Périphériques
description: Printing and peripherals of this computer: print service state (Windows Spooler, CUPS) and its errors over 7 days; printers (state, problem such as offline, paper or toner, default, address or port with credentials masked, driver or model, shared, network, virtual PDF/XPS printers); print jobs waiting in the queues; scanners (Windows imaging devices, SANE scanimage, cached 10 min); Bluetooth adapter and paired devices (connected, type, battery). Findings flag a stopped print service, a printer in trouble, stuck jobs (older than 30 min or in error), no default printer, a shared printer, a low Bluetooth battery and Bluetooth turned off with paired devices. Clearing a queue and restarting the spooler: maintenance_reset_print_queue.

functions.name: get_printer
functions.title: Détail d'une imprimante
functions.help: Détail d'une imprimante (par défaut si le champ est vide) : état, problème signalé, pilote, adresse, partage, documents en attente, et si elle répond sur le réseau.
functions.description: One printer in detail (default: the default printer): state and problem, driver or model, port and address (credentials masked), network reachability (IPP 631 / RAW 9100), sharing, CUPS state reasons and location, and its waiting jobs.

parameters.name: name

functions.help: Documents en attente d'impression, toutes imprimantes ou une seule : propriétaire, heure d'envoi, nombre de pages, état. Un document ancien ou en erreur bloque souvent la file.
functions.description: Print jobs waiting in the queues: printer, job number, document name, owner, submit time, pages, size, state.

functions.name: print_test_page
functions.title: Imprimer une page de test
functions.help: Imprime la page de test de l'imprimante (par défaut si le champ est vide) pour vérifier que l'impression fonctionne. Consomme une feuille.
functions.description: Prints the test page of a printer (default: the default printer) to check that printing works. Windows: Win32_Printer.PrintTestPage; Linux: lp with the CUPS test page. Blocked for virtual printers (PDF, XPS, file) and stopped or offline printers. Uses one sheet of paper.
